questions.question: Do I need to complete all 3 weekly responsibilities every week?
questions.answer: Yes. Weekly responsibilities are the core activities expected from every ambassador and contribute toward your progression in the program.

questions.question: What counts as recruiting a new player?
questions.answer: A new player is someone who joins your campus WhatsApp group through your referral and remains active in the community.

questions.question: Can I recruit students from other colleges?
questions.answer: No. Recruitment should focus on students from your own campus unless specifically mentioned otherwise.

questions.question: How do I prove that I completed the "Assault Mastery" task?
questions.answer: You may be required to submit screenshots, invite records, or complete a reporting form provided by the program team.

questions.question: What qualifies as a Classic Match for the "Squad Up" mission?
questions.answer: Any eligible BGMI Classic Match played with students from your college community counts toward the requirement.

questions.question: Do all 5 matches need to be played with different students?
questions.answer: No. Unless stated otherwise, you can complete the matches with any eligible students from your campus.

questions.question: What kind of technical queries qualify for the "Medic" mission?
questions.answer: Examples include Discord access issues, reporting problems, registration queries, event participation issues, or other ambassador-related support requests.

questions.question: How will the program verify that I helped another ambassador?
questions.answer: The Discord moderation team or designated community managers may verify interactions through support channels.

questions.question: Who can participate in Elite Missions?
questions.answer: Only ambassadors who have reached Diamond Rank or higher.

questions.question: Can I complete the same Elite Mission multiple times?
questions.answer: This depends on program rules. Unless stated otherwise, each approved mission may be rewarded once per activation period.

questions.question: What qualifies as a collaborative tournament for "The Clutch"?
questions.answer: A tournament jointly organized between two or more participating colleges with proper coordination and reporting.

questions.question: Do I need approval before organizing a rival college tournament?
questions.answer: Yes. It's recommended to seek approval from the program team before announcing or conducting the event.

questions.question: What platforms can I use for the "Streamer" mission?
questions.answer: Any approved streaming platform such as YouTube, Instagram Live, Discord Stage, or other platforms specified by the organizers.

questions.question: Does the stream need commentary to qualify?
questions.answer: Yes. Commentary is a mandatory part of the "Streamer" mission requirements.

questions.question: What are Bounty Missions?
questions.answer: Bounty Missions are limited-time flash challenges announced by the program team that offer bonus RP rewards.

questions.question: How will I know when a Bounty Mission goes live?
questions.answer: Notifications will be sent through official communication channels such as WhatsApp, Discord, email, or app notifications.
Only the first 10 campuses that successfully complete and submit the required activity will receive the bonus reward.

questions.question: If multiple students from my campus submit entries, which one counts?
questions.answer: The earliest valid submission from your campus will generally be considered.

questions.question: What happens if my submission is incomplete or unclear?
questions.answer: Incomplete, late, or invalid submissions may not qualify for the reward.

questions.question: Can Bounty Missions be repeated?
questions.answer: Yes. New Bounty Missions may be announced throughout the 90-day program with different objectives and rewards.

questions.question: What is RP?
questions.answer: RP (Royale Points) is the progression currency used to track performance, unlock ranks, and compete on leaderboards.

questions.question: When are RP rewards credited?
questions.answer: RP is typically credited after successful verification of completed missions.

questions.question: What happens if two ambassadors claim the same achievement?
questions.answer: The program team will review timestamps and supporting evidence before awarding RP.

questions.question: Can RP be deducted?
questions.answer: Yes. Fraudulent submissions, rule violations, or misuse of the program may result in RP penalties or disqualification.

questions.question: What if I miss a week's responsibilities?
questions.answer: You may lose out on RP and leaderboard progression, but you can continue participating in future activities unless otherwise specified.

questions.question: Is there a leaderboard?
questions.answer: Yes. RP earned through weekly responsibilities, Elite Missions, and Bounty Missions contributes to ambassador rankings and leaderboard positions.

questions.question: Can I jump ranks quickly through Elite and Bounty Missions?
questions.answer: Yes. Bonus missions are designed to accelerate progression for highly active ambassadors.
